question: In a certain code language, ‘Here we go west’ is written as ‘8 6 4 9’, ‘West and east best’ is written as ‘4 @ # pr’ and ‘East direction sun’ is written as ‘# jt qm’. Which one of the following is the possible code for ‘direction east’ in that code language?
solution: Given: ‘Here we go west’ is written as ‘8 6 4 9’, ‘West and east best’ is written as ‘4 @ # pr’ ‘East direction sun’ is written as ‘# jt qm’
